description: This file implements an audio resampler class using the resampy library for high-quality sample rate conversion. It defines the ResampyResampler class which inherits from BaseAudioResampler and provides an asynchronous resample method that processes raw audio bytes.

classes.name: ResampyResampler
classes.description: An audio resampler implementation that uses the resampy library's Kaiser window filter for high-quality resampling.

methods.name: __init__(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the resampy resampler with optional keyword arguments.

methods.name: bytes resample(self, audio: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int)
methods.description: Asynchronously resamples input audio bytes from the original sample rate to the target sample rate using the resampy library.
